This is a list of the 31 [[Power Moon]]s that can be found in the [[Cap Kingdom]] of ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. {|class="wikitable sortable col4left col5left mario sm" style="width:100%;text-align:center" !!data-sort-type="number"|# !class="unsortable" width="192px"|Image !data-sort-type="alphabetical"|Name !class="unsortable"|Location !Availability |- |1 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 1.png|192px]] |''Frog-Jumping Above the Fog'' |The player must [[capture]] a [[frog]] near the start of the kingdom and use it to jump across some floating hat-platforms near the south side of the kingdom. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |2 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 2.png|192px]] |''Frog-Jumping from the Top Deck'' |The player must capture a frog near the start of the kingdom and use it to high-jump from a stack of two hat-ships in the Central Plaza. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |3 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 3.png|192px]] |''Cap Kingdom Timer Challenge 1'' |Near the base of [[Top-Hat Tower]], the player can find a [[Scarecrow (object)|scarecrow]]. Mario must throw Cappy at the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal a Power Moon at the other side of [[Sometimes Bridge]]. Mario must then collect the Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |4 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 4.png|192px]] |''Good Evening, Captain Toad!'' |At the top of the Top-Hat Tower, the player can find Captain Toad observing the moon. Talking to Captain Toad will award the player with a Power Moon. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |5 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 5.png|192px]] |''Shopping in Bonneton'' |The player can purchase a Power Moon from the [[Crazy Cap]] Shop for 100 yellow [[Coin]]s. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |6 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 6.png|192px]] |''Skimming the Poison Tide'' |The player needs to capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly to the back side of the Top-Hat Tower, where a door leading to a secret area can be found. Mario should enter the door and then collect the five [[Moon Shard]]s within in order to reveal a Power Moon. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |7 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 7.png|192px]] |''Slipping Through the Poison Tide'' |In the area with the "Skimming the Poison Tide" Power Moon, the player should use a Paragoomba to fly under the platform with the exit door in order to reach the other side of the wall, where some platforms can be found. Mario should scale up these platforms in order to reach a hidden Power Moon at the top. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |8 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 8.png|192px]] |''Push-Block Peril'' |Near the top of the Top-Hat Tower, the player can find a door leading to a secret area. Mario should enter this door to find an area with several blocks that go in and out of the wall. If the player can successfully traverse these blocks, they will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |9 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 9.png|192px]] |''Hidden Among the Push-Blocks'' |In the area with the "Push-Block Peril" Power Moon, the player can find a hidden Power Moon tucked away in a hole among one of the L-shaped blocks. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |10 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 10.png|192px]] |''Searching the Frog Pond'' |At the north side of the Central Plaza, the player can find a hidden door leading to a secret area. Mario should enter this area and then capture a nearby frog to collect five Moon Shards, which will reward him with a Power Moon. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |11 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 11.png|192px]] |''Secrets of the Frog Pond'' |In the area with the "Searching the Frog Pond" Power Moon, the player needs to use a frog to jump up to a high ledge located on the back wall, where a Power Moon can be found. |Available after powering up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom. |- |12 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 12.png|192px]] |data-sort-value="Forgotten Treasure, The"|''The Forgotten Treasure'' |In the Central Plaza, the player should look for a [[Bonneter]] atop of a top-hat-shaped platform on a hill. Mario should talk to him, which will trigger a quest to find a "lost treasure". Cappy will lead the player around the area in search of the treasure, which is Cappy's lucky Power Moon. It is eventually found by ground pounding the stair next to the southern adjoining span of Glasses Bridge. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |13 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 13.png|192px]] |''Taxi Flying Through Bonneton'' |In the Central Plaza, Mario must capture the pair of binoculars (in the north-western corner) and use them to look at a taxi flying in front of the moon. If the player stares at it for a few seconds, it will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |14 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 14.png|192px]] |''Bonneter Blockade'' |In the Central Plaza, the player should look for a Power Moon in a small alcove guarded by a Bonneter. If Mario captures a nearby [[Paragoomba]] and takes it to the Bonneter, he will get scared and run off, allowing access to the Power Moon. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |15 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 15.png|192px]] |''Cap Kingdom Regular Cup'' |Near the top of the Top-Hat Tower, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario should participate in the race and then reach the finish line (located near the Odyssey) in first place. This will reward him with a Power Moon. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |16 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 16.png|192px]] |''Peach in the Cap Kingdom'' |In the Central Plaza, the player can find [[Princess Peach]]. Talking to her will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom and talking to the Toad outside Peach's Castle (Mushroom Kingdom). |- |17 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 17.png|192px]] |''Found with Cap Kingdom Art'' |In the north-eastern corner of the Central Plaza, the player can find some Hint Art showing the location of a Power Moon hidden in a different kingdom. Mario should travel to the location shown (the [[Moon Kingdom]]) and ground pound the spot south of the Lochlady at the start in order to receive this Power Moon. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |18 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 18.png|192px]] |''Next to Glasses Bridge'' |The player can find this Power Moon on top of a top-hat-shaped platform next to [[Glasses Bridge]]. |Available after opening this kingdom's [[Moon Rock]]. |- |19 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 19.png|192px]] |''Danger Sign'' |The player can notice this Power Moon on a skull-marked sign over the fog near the Odyssey. To reach it, Mario must capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly over to the sign and collect the Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |20 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 20.png|192px]] |''Under the Big One's Brim'' |The player can find this Power Moon floating in the air below the top of the Top-Hat Tower. To collect it, Mario must simply drop onto it from the top of the Top-Hat Tower. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |21 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 21.png|192px]] |''Fly to the Edge of the Fog'' |To collect this Power Moon, Mario must capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly to the fog in the north-eastern corner of the kingdom (behind the Top-Hat Tower), where the Moon can be seen glowing under the fog here. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |22 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 22.png|192px]] |''Spin the Hat, Get a Prize'' |In the Central Plaza, the player must head to the arch at the entranceway and throw Cappy at the glowing hat-symbol here. This will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |23 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 23.png|192px]] |''Hidden in a Sunken Hat'' |Near Sometimes Bridge, the player should look for a top-hat-shaped platform with a glowing pole atop it in the fog. Mario must capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly out to this top-hat platform. He must then throw Cappy at the glowing pole on the top-hat and hold him there for a few seconds, which will cause a Power Moon to appear. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |24 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 24.png|192px]] |''Fog-Shrouded Platform'' |Near the door leading to the "Searching the Frog Pond" Power Moon area, the player should notice a glowing spot on the ground just under the fog. If Mario ground pounds this glowing spot, he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |25 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 25.png|192px]] |''Bird Traveling in the Fog'' |The player must run into a small bird (that flies over the fog around the entire kingdom) by using a Paragoomba. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |26 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 26.png|192px]] |''Caught Hopping Near the Ship!'' |On a tall hill near the Odyssey, the player can find a rabbit. If Mario catches the rabbit, he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |27 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 27.png|192px]] |''Taking Notes: In the Fog'' |To the west of the Central Plaza area, the player should look for a top-hat-shaped platform with a rainbow-colored treble clef atop it. Mario must capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly out to the treble clef, which (when collected) will temporarily spawn some [[note]]s over the fog. If the player can collect all of the notes before they disappear, Mario will receive a Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |28 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 28.png|192px]] |''Cap Kingdom Timer Challenge 2'' |In the south-eastern corner of the Central Plaza, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario should throw Cappy at the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some moving platforms and a key (along with a keyhole). Mario needs to then collect the key, which will unlock the keyhole and reveal a Power Moon. Finally, the player must collect this Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |29 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 29.png|192px]] |''Cap Kingdom Master Cup'' |Near the top of the Top-Hat Tower, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario should participate in the race and then reach the finish line (located near the Odyssey) in first place. This will reward him with a Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock and collecting the "Cap Kingdom Regular Cup" Power Moon. |- |30 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 30.png|192px]] |''Roll On and On'' |On the west side of the Central Plaza, the player should look for a [[Moon Pipe]]. This will take Mario to a secret area with a large slide. If the player can avoid the [[Spiny|Spinies]] on the slide and reach the end, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |31 |[[File:SMO Cap Moon 31.png|192px]] |''Precision Rolling'' |In the area with the "Roll On and On" Power Moon, the player must carefully roll down a small side path near the start to find this Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |} {|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed navbox mario sm" !colspan=3|
